Actual: Finance month tile before seeding: This month ₹5.4L 28 expenses in Sep 2026 | ✔ Finance in this tenant derives its month from the latest submitted record (no date-range selector exists in the UI); the active month is Sep 2026 | seeded record dated 2026-09-30 (last day of a 30-day month): EXP-1032 submitted for ₹1,111. See it on your dashboard or open the expense. | EXP-1032 su | ✔ boundary record dated 2026-09-30 created | RESTRICTED: only the 30-day-month boundary (2026-09-30) could be seeded: 2026-02-28, 2028-02-29, 2026-04-30 and the next-day controls would make older months non-latest in a shared tenant, and the app has no month selector, so the planned Feb/Feb-leap/Apr datasets cannot be queried.
description: Seed unique non-Draft records on 2026-02-28, 2028-02-29, and 2026-04-30, plus a next-day control record for each selected month.
expectedResult: The isolated dataset contains the planned last-day and outside-range records with recorded expected counts and totals.

comment:
Expected: Each query completes without a Data Fabric 400 or invalid-date error, and the selected range is shown correctly.
Actual: ✔ Finance loads for the 30-day month (Sep 2026) with no Data Fabric 400 / invalid-date / error text | month tile: This month ₹5.4L 29 expenses in Sep 2026 | RESTRICTED: the app offers no date-range selector, so February 2026 / 2028 / April 2026 could not be selected; only the latest month (Sep 2026, 30 days) was queried.
description: Open Finance and select the date range for February 2026, then repeat for February 2028 and April 2026.
expectedResult: Each query completes without a Data Fabric 400 or invalid-date error, and the selected range is shown correctly.

comment:
Expected: The 28th and 29th day records are included exactly once, the next-day controls are excluded, and no stale month rows remain.
Actual: BLOCKED: February 2026 and leap-year February 2028 cannot be queried: Finance has no month selector and always uses the latest month with data; older months are not reachable without deleting or dating-out newer shared records.
description: Inspect the February 2026 and leap-year February 2028 results.
expectedResult: The 28th and 29th day records are included exactly once, the next-day controls are excluded, and no stale month rows remain.

comment:
Expected: The April 30th record is included, April 31st is never queried, and the Finance count and total equal the expected boundary-inclusive values.
Actual: Finance month tile now: This month ₹5.4L 29 expenses in Sep 2026; DF record: {"ExpenseCode":"EXP-1032","ExpenseDate":"2026-09-30","Amount":1111} | ✔ the 2026-09-30 record exists in Data Fabric with the correct date | ✔ the 30-day month is queried through its actual last day (Sep 2026 tile renders; the previous hard-coded -31 bound would have caused an invalid-date 400) | RESTRICTED: April 2026 (30-day) was not the latest month, so its aggregate could not be compared; the equivalent 30-day boundary was verified for Sep 2026 only. Count/total precomputed comparison for the whole month was not performed.
description: Inspect the April 2026 results and compare the displayed aggregate count and total with the precomputed values.
expectedResult: The April 30th record is included, April 31st is never queried, and the Finance count and total equal the expected boundary-inclusive values.
